topics.title: Complex Speed Sounds: every spelling of a sound
topics.intro: You know the Speed Sounds. Now for the tricky spellings! The “ay” sound can be ay, ai, a-e, but also eigh (eight), ey (they) and even ea (great).
topics.teach: Teach me three different ways to spell the “or” sound.
topics.talk: This carries on from the Read Write Inc. Set 3 Speed Sounds. Ask {him} how many ways {she} can spell the “ay” sound.

topics.title: Long words: chunk by chunk
topics.intro: Long words are easy if you take them in chunks. Clap the beats (syllables): ad-ven-ture. Read each chunk with Fred in your head, then put them together.
topics.teach: Clap the beats in “caterpillar” and tell me how many there are.
topics.talk: When {she} gets stuck on a long word, cover all but the first chunk, then reveal one chunk at a time.
